annotations.text:
v2 — metrics that matter for brand deals.
Every figure shown is obtainable through the official APIs once the creator connects: YouTube Analytics gives per-video retention (audienceWatchRatio), day-by-day views, age/gender/country/device; Instagram gives reach, non-follower share, saves, Reel watch time and follower demographics; X gives impressions, engagement, profile and link clicks (no demographics).
Not shown anywhere because no API exposes it: YouTube impressions/CTR, X demographics, Instagram retention curves.
Directory carries the same metric set as the profile: platform tabs switch the columns, retention sparkline inline, audience column, compare tray for shortlists.

Profile: ‘what a sponsor gets per video’ strip → retention curve (pre-roll / mid-roll / end markers) + view velocity → audience, geography, engagement per 1K + cadence → per-video table with retention sparklines. Window and content-type switches at the top apply to everything below.

Instagram variant of the same layout: reach split followers vs. new audience, watch time as share of Reel length (no retention curve on IG), saves/shares per 1K reached, profile visits and website taps.

v5 tone: soft green-tinted page (#f3f8f5) with white cards, mint bands (#dcf0e4) for the home hero and profile identity, emerald (#059669) for primary actions, active filters and chart marks — the same colour family as the Verified badge, so green reads as ‘verified data’ everywhere. No black surfaces, no gradients.
